description.value: Samurai Sushi is a locally owned Japanese restaurant established in 2001, situated in Whistler's Nesters area. It serves sushi, bento boxes, teriyaki dishes, and healthy sides, alongside a sister takeout-focused location (Samurai Bowl) in Creekside. The restaurant is notably eco-conscious, using compostable and recyclable containers and cutlery for its takeout orders.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms Samurai Sushi is an active Japanese restaurant at 210-7015 Nesters Rd in Whistler's Nesters area, open 7 days a week. Takeout and online ordering are prominently featured throughout the site; vegetarian options are explicitly mentioned on the front page and about page. No evidence of bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, water refill, or cycling-specific amenities appears anywhere on the site.
concerns: OSM record has no address; address sourced from website contact page (210-7015 Nesters Rd, Whistler, BC V8E 0X1) — contact_confirmed.address set to null.

Website covers two distinct Whistler businesses (Samurai Sushi at Nesters and Samurai Bowl at Creekside); a separate OSM node may exist for the Creekside location, which could create a duplicate listing.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Business is clearly active and cyclist-accessible in Whistler, but no bike parking, washrooms, or water refill evidence exists on the website, leaving all three required criteria unconfirmed. An on-the-ground check is needed to satisfy minimum WWC requirements before inclusion.
enrichment_extras.notes: Party platters available on request per website; gift certificates usable across all four Samurai locations (two Whistler, two Squamish). Allergy requests must be made by phone, not via online order notes.
